description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the AbstractProtocolAdapterBase class in the Eclipse Hono project, specifically testing its startup, connection handling, property management, registration assertions, payload validation, address validation, and connection limit checks.

classes.name: AbstractProtocolAdapterBaseTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AbstractProtocolAdapterBase, testing its startup, connection, property handling, registration assertions, payload validation, address validation, and connection limit enforcement.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the test fixture before each test.

methods.name: testStartInternalFailsIfNoTypeNameIsDefined
methods.description: Tests that starting the adapter without type name fails with an IllegalStateException.

methods.name: testStartInternalConnectsToServices
methods.description: Verifies that the adapter connects to all necessary services during startup.

methods.name: testCallbacksInvokedOnReconnect
methods.description: Ensures reconnection callbacks are invoked correctly when the command connection is re-established.

methods.name: givenAnAdapterConfiguredWithServiceClients
methods.description: Helper method to configure the adapter with mocked service clients and handlers.

methods.name: testAddPropertiesAddsStandardProperties
methods.description: Checks that standard properties are added correctly to downstream messages, including adapter name and tenant info.

methods.name: testAddPropertiesIgnoresDefaultsIfDisabled
methods.description: Ensures default properties are not added when defaults are disabled in configuration.

methods.name: testAddPropertiesUsesMaxTtlByDefault
methods.description: Verifies TTL is set to maxTtl value when no other TTL is specified.

methods.name: testGetRegistrationAssertionSucceedsForExistingDevice
methods.description: Checks successful retrieval of registration assertions for existing devices.

methods.name: testGetRegistrationAssertionFailsWith404ForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Verifies failure with 404 error when device registration does not exist.

methods.name: testGetRegistrationAssertionFailsWith403ForNonMatchingTenant
methods.description: Ensures request fails with 403 when attempting to get assertion for device in different tenant.

methods.name: testEmptyNotificationWithoutPayload
methods.description: Validates that empty notification types without payload are considered valid.

methods.name: testEmptyNotificationWithPayload
methods.description: Validates that empty notification types with payload are invalid.

methods.name: testNonEmptyGeneralMessage
methods.description: Confirms that messages with payloads are valid regardless of content type.

methods.name: testNonEmptyMessageWithoutContentType
methods.description: Confirms that messages with payload and no content type are valid.

methods.name: testEmptyGeneralMessage
methods.description: Ensures that messages without payload and with content type are invalid.

methods.name: testValidateAddressUsesDeviceIdentityForAddressWithoutTenant
methods.description: Checks that device identity is used to validate address when tenant ID is missing.

methods.name: testCheckConnectionLimitFailsIfConnectionLimitIsReached
methods.description: Verifies that connection limit check fails if tenant already reached max connections.

methods.name: testCheckConnectionLimitFailsIfMessageLimitIsReached
methods.description: Verifies that message limit check fails if tenant has reached message limit.

methods.name: newProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Helper to create a new mock-driven instance of AbstractProtocolAdapterBase with specified properties.

methods.name: newRegistrationAssertionResult
methods.description: Creates a sample registration assertion JSON object, optionally with a default content type.
